guards.description: Ensures reference window timestamp bounds strictly precede current evaluation window bounds.
Verifies no feature in drift monitoring contracts depends on future-dated observations or lookahead labels.
Prohibits full-text articles, raw HTML bodies, and scraped news corpora in drift monitoring contracts.
Prohibits deletion, truncation, or in-place overwrite of underlying historical parquet/csv files.
Excludes trading targets, execution artifacts, and forward prices from drift contracts.
